fusions.name: Stampede Down the Lane
fusions.desc: You rush up to 6 tiles to a target, then drive the levelled staff through a cone 3.5 tiles long. It deals 12 damage to everything in it.

fusions.name: Lean Into the Traces
fusions.desc: Sets the staff across your shoulders and walks it through the target. It deals 30 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Rumination
fusions.desc: You rest your weight on the staff. It restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Drove Road
fusions.desc: On paved ground, you deal 12% more damage.
